No congressional record was located this pass. Note a cross-lens inconsistency in the research pool, where the identical event was tagged both attested and unverified. The coordinate is the Palacio del Congreso, corrected from a figure in the pool that pointed at the Plaza de Mayo instead.

stops.stop: Buenos Aires, one hundred years old
stops.date_confidence: reconstruction for the celebration. The birth date of 12 May 1899 is attested; the reported attendance of more than three thousand people at the centenary festivities comes only from the foundation's own institutional account, and no press coverage confirming the figure was located this pass.

stops.date_confidence: attested: Hinduism Today, the Dawn obituary and Time all report the death in Buenos Aires at 102, seventeen days short of 103, and Hinduism Today reports a stroke in February 2002 that paralysed her right side. A minor discrepancy stands: Dawn's dateline gives 26 April against the 25 April carried elsewhere. Contemporary obituaries note that no official cause of death was disclosed.

stops.stop: Rio de la Plata, the ashes
stops.date_confidence: attested for the fact: Hinduism Today reports that her body was cremated and her ashes scattered in the Rio de la Plata. The exact date and point are not recorded, and the coordinate is a plausible position in the estuary off Buenos Aires; the research pool carried two figures for this event some thirty-five kilometres apart, and the nearer one is used in both places. There is no grave, marker, statue or plaque for her in Riga, at Tecate, or anywhere else that could be located this pass.
